Class DefaultChemObjectWriter

java.lang.Object
org.openscience.cdk.io.ChemObjectIO
org.openscience.cdk.io.DefaultChemObjectWriter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Closeable, AutoCloseable, IChemObjectIO, IChemObjectWriter
Direct Known Subclasses:
CDKSourceCodeWriter, CMLWriter, CrystClustWriter, GaussianInputWriter, HINWriter, MDLRXNWriter, MDLV2000Writer, MDLV3000Writer, Mol2Writer, Mopac7Writer, PDBWriter, RGroupQueryWriter, RssWriter, SDFWriter, ShelXWriter, SMILESWriter, XYZWriter
public abstract class DefaultChemObjectWriter extends ChemObjectIO implements IChemObjectWriter
Abstract class that ChemObjectReader's can implement to have it take care of basic stuff, like managing the ReaderListeners.
